# Secure Electric Fencing Jeffreys Bay

> Electric fence installation, repairs, maintenance and compliance certificates in Jeffreys Bay, Eastern Cape, South Africa. Part of the Secure Electric Fencing family, established in the Vaal Triangle.

Phone and WhatsApp: 083 280 9991. Based in Jeffreys Bay.

## Services
- [Home installations](https://sites.factsmith.co.za/secure-electric-fencing-jbay/services/#homes): Wall-top and freestanding electric fences designed around your property, with energiser, battery backup, warning signs and earthing.
- [Repairs and call-outs](https://sites.factsmith.co.za/secure-electric-fencing-jbay/services/#repairs): Fence beeping, tripping or dead? We trace the fault, from shorts and broken wires to tired batteries and failed energisers, and fix it on the spot where we can.
- [Gate electrification](https://sites.factsmith.co.za/secure-electric-fencing-jbay/services/#gates): Electric fencing carried across sliding and swing gates, with gate contacts so the gate opens normally and the fence stays live.
- [Compliance certificates](https://sites.factsmith.co.za/secure-electric-fencing-jbay/compliance-certificate/): Inspection, repairs if needed, and the Electric Fence System Certificate of Compliance for property transfers.
- [Maintenance plans](https://sites.factsmith.co.za/secure-electric-fencing-jbay/services/#maintenance): Scheduled visits to test voltage, clear vegetation, check earthing and replace batteries before they fail.
- [Business, complexes and smallholdings](https://sites.factsmith.co.za/secure-electric-fencing-jbay/services/#business): Larger perimeters for shops, complexes, light industry and smallholdings around Humansdorp and the Kouga farms.

## Common questions
- Do I need an electric fence certificate to sell my house? Yes. Since October 2012 a valid Electric Fence System Certificate of Compliance is required before a property with an electric fence can transfer. A registered installer inspects the system and issues it.
- How much does an electric fence cost in Jeffreys Bay? It depends on the length of the boundary, the number of strands, the energiser and the gates. Most homes are quoted per metre plus the energiser and battery. We quote free on site.
- Why does my electric fence keep beeping? The beeping is the energiser telling you something is wrong: usually a short from plants or a broken wire, a weak battery after load-shedding, or a poor earth. Check for anything touching the wires, then call us if it continues.
- How long does an installation take? A typical home takes one to two days once materials are on site.
- Does salt air affect an electric fence? Yes. On the coast, standard fittings rust and wires lose tension faster. We use corrosion-resistant hardware and recommend a yearly service.
- Can you look after my fence while I am away? Yes. Our maintenance plans include scheduled checks, battery replacement and call-outs, so the fence works when you are not there.
- Do you cover Humansdorp and St Francis Bay? Yes. We cover the whole Kouga area, including Humansdorp, St Francis Bay, Cape St Francis, Aston Bay and Paradise Beach.
